local_context.value: 39.6% of Hilton Head Island residents were 65 or older at the 2020 census (median age 59.3; population 37,661). Humid subtropical climate, about 51.4 inches of rain a year. Broad Creek, a tidal marsh, separates the two halves of the island; the 1893 Sea Islands hurricane brought a 16-foot storm surge. The Town's Building Service Center has Flood Hazard, Flood Elevation Certificates and Substantial Improvement & Damage pages.

neighborhoods.value: Sea Pines (incl. Harbour Town), Hilton Head Plantation, Palmetto Dunes, Shipyard, Port Royal Plantation, Colleton River Plantation, Windmill Harbor, Mariner's Cove, Blue Heron Point

place_entities.value: Sea Pines Resort; Harbour Town Golf Links; Mitchelville (Freedom Park community for formerly enslaved people); Hilton Head Island Airport; Hilton Head Medical Center & Clinics (named in Wikipedia article, no separate URL)
